title: Ecuador Narco-Security Emergency Tracker Update — Oct 08, 2026
summary: Noboa signed Decree 498 on September 15, declaring a 60-day state of emergency in eight provinces and three cantons, citing 442 homicides between August 16 and September 10. A curfew from 00:00 to 05:00 applied September 17–30 in Guayas, El Oro, Los Ríos and Manabí, the third of 2026. Home inviolability is suspended, allowing immediate raids. No other verified developments were found this run.

title: Ecuador Narco-Security Emergency Tracker Update — Aug 21, 2026
summary: President Noboa extended Ecuador's state of emergency 30 more days across 10 provinces on August 14, 2026, citing 238,404 emergency calls logged in five weeks. Gang violence continued: three children were killed in a Guayaquil home invasion on August 14, and four alleged Los Lobos members died in a Los Choneros raid in Babahoyo on August 16. The US Treasury sanctioned 15 individuals and companies plus 10 fishing vessels tied to a Manta-based cocaine network on August 20, and Argentina designated Los Lobos, Los Choneros, and Chone Killers as terrorist groups during a August 6 visit by President Milei. The US had separately designated Chone Killers a Foreign Terrorist Organization on July 2, 2026.
